title: Visual Recipe Edit-Goety

body:
Visual Recipe Edit-Goety is an addon mod for Goety.

It provides a visual GUI that allows you to create, edit, and delete new recipes, modify existing Goety recipes, and even define custom ritual types. Changes take effect after executing /reload or rejoining the world.

Details
Open the main menu with /vre goety gui to browse all recipe categories:
Rituals, Braziers, Cursed Infuser, Soul Absorber, Brewing, and Pulverize.
Select any type to enter its dedicated editor, which offers fields tailored to that recipe, such as:

Item inputs / outputs

Soul cost

Processing time

Entity selectors

Tag selectors

Editors come with built-in item, entity, and tag selectors, all supporting search in both English and Chinese.

In the recipe list screen you can search through all registered recipes of that type. Click Edit to modify a recipe, or Delete to remove it (deletion is only allowed for recipes you have created yourself).

All user‑created recipes are saved under:
config/visual_recipe_edit_goety/rituals/data/goety/recipes/

Ritual recipes support choosing a factory type (craft, summon, convert, etc.) and dynamically display the corresponding fields (output item, entity to summon, entity to convert, etc.). Optional conditions such as sacrifice entities or structure requirements can be enabled.

The mod also features a custom ritual type system, allowing you to create new ritual types with:

Custom block requirements

Weather / time restrictions

Y‑level constraints

Custom finish sounds and particle colors

Full Chinese and English support is included – the interface language follows the game’s language setting automatically.

Commands
/vre goety gui – opens the recipe category selection screen, where you can create or manage recipes.

Notes
This is an addon mod for Goety and requires it to be installed.

After adding, editing, or deleting recipes, you must run /reload or re‑enter the world for the changes to take effect.
